newsitem.title: USA: Teleport seeks more local phone service.
newsitem.headline: Teleport seeks more local phone service.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc (TCG) said Wednesday it has filed applications to provide local telephone service in Minnesota, Kentucky and Ohio.
The Minnesota application seeks to provide service in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area, and in Kentucky, TCG has asked to provide local phone service in the Covington area.
TCG already has approval from the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio to provide local phone service in the Cleveland area where it is in the process of building a fiber optic network.
TCG said it is also requesting local telephone exchange carrier status in Columbus and developing a network to serve the Cincinnati metropolitan area which includes Covington.

"We view these applications to provide local phone exchange service as a natural progression of TCG's expansion plan," said Madelon Kuchera, TCG's Regional Vice President for Regulatory and External Affairs.

TCG said it is also seeking permission to expand its local phone exchange into the western half of St. Charles County, Missouri, northwest of St. Louis. TCG is currently operating as a local carrier in the St. Louis area.
TCG is in 57 U.S. markets and is developing more.
